{{Top|leg}}
'''Chromanins''' were part of a [[Krikthasi]]'s biology that allowed them to communicate by changing their body color. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] could not decipher the language, but believed that blue and shades of green were used to represent anger and aggression, yellow was analogous to territory, while red and oranges indicated a desire to talk.
